section.45: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

45.name_native: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said in his khutbah, while he was leaning with his back against the Ka'bah:"The fingers are the same
